venues.name: D&C DC
venues.weather: One of the warmer days of the year thus far
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Saturday 3/7.** Really solid night. Garden steady, Jada handled service with Josh supporting at busy moments, solid food going out. Marquee: bar top filled first then the floor; steady flow until after 11p and late walk-ins right to last call; great communication, shoutout to everyone. Kitchen: BOH did a great job; James ran food on the floor and Jamal handled the late-night dish pit. MOD: Josh / Kevin.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Saturday 3/7.** Incredibly strong first thirty minutes with a line down the block; strong pace but slowed by an excess of second-turn reservations, making flow choppy. Hosted lower Manhattan service-industry friends and broader industry who bought merch. Toast transition seems ok; ordering will be faster long term with correct button pushing. 6 large parties, 11 solos. Comps $144.66. Top sellers: Masari, Fries, Core Slight. Door: line to start and full bar ~6:30; strange lull with empty gaps ~8 and 9, full by 10 with waitlist running smoothly, died ~11:30, filled again after midnight with no waitlist; full, calm room at close. No no-shows. Kitchen: good work tonight.
